## Fixed

- **The firewall came back.** Janitor's firewall started blocking things all over for apps that aren't the website, its own app included. Update and it's gone: Butler goes the way the website goes now. Thanks to merttolo for reporting it.
- **Coming back from a character** no longer throws you to the top of the home list.
- The retry after a firewall block no longer dies with "no connection".

## New

- **Pictures in your message**, a Butler special (beta). Tap the picture key, pick one picture, and a model of yours that can see writes it into your line in your own voice, right where you put it. You read it, change what you like, and send it yourself. Nothing of the picture goes to Janitor, only to your proxy. Settings › Model › Pictures use picks the model; Settings › Chat has the switches. (argadega457)
- **Agent mode**, a Butler special (beta, proxies with a reasoning model). The reply is drafted, checked against goals strictly, fixed where it fails with exact edits or a rewrite, and only then delivered. Pick the effort and add your own goals in Settings › Model. The thought panel shows every step, and each opens to what happened inside.
- **Share a bot.** A share key on any character page hands its Janitor link to your phone's share sheet. (zorvae)
- **Edit your persona from the chat.** A pencil beside each persona in Play as opens its editor. (argadega457)
- **The keyboard goes down when you send.** Settings › Chat if you'd rather it stayed up. (zorvae)
- **Your own thinking words.** Claude's list is editable, and you can add lists of your own and switch any of them on or off. (zorvae)
- **Rerolls stack.** "Slow down" and "More emotional" together, plus whatever you type. (zorvae)
- **Home as pages**, if you'd rather not scroll endlessly: Settings › Look › Home list. (Key_Coffee_4684)
- **Settings got pages.** Model, Chat, Look, Rich typing, Butler specials, App and Updates, each on its own page with its own icon. Options that only work under another are drawn as its branches, and betas say so.

## Install

Grab **Butler-0.4.0.apk** below. It installs over any earlier version and keeps your chats and settings.
